title: Presentation Storytelling
intent: formative · Communication & Reflection (Applying) · click through the process
statement: Structure data as an unfolding narrative — beginning, tension, and resolution — not a list of facts.

steps.title: Set the scene
steps.text: Open with the situation and why the audience should care about it.

steps.title: Introduce the tension
steps.text: Name the problem or surprise — the gap that creates the need to know.

steps.title: Build through the data
steps.text: Reveal the evidence as a rising path toward the answer, one step at a time.

steps.title: Reach the resolution
steps.text: Deliver the finding as the pay-off the tension has been building to.

steps.title: Land the so-what
steps.text: Close on what it means and what should change — the reason it mattered.

feedForward.text: Reshape one result as a three-beat story: situation, problem, finding. If there is no tension, there is no story.
